title: Massive, Absorption-selected Galaxies at Intermediate Redshifts
question: Do high-metallicity absorption-selected (DLA/sub-DLA) galaxies at z~0.5-0.8 have molecular gas properties similar to emission-selected star-forming galaxies?

data.sensitivity: RMS 150-275 uJy per 100 km/s channel; continuum RMS ~13-20 uJy (~40 uJy for B0827+243)

what.value: COLD GASS comparison sample (212 CO(1-0) detections)

evidence.quote: the *COLD GASS* sample at low redshifts ($z \lesssim 0.05$), with 212 CO(1$-$0) detections
the *PHIBSS* sample at high redshifts ($z \approx 1.3,2.2$) with 49 CO(3$-$2) detections

what.value: SFRs from [OII] or Hbeta lines, or U-band continuum for B1629+120

evidence.quote: the star formation rates (SFRs) of the DLA galaxies were inferred from either the \[Oii\]$\lambda$3727Å or H$\beta$$\lambda$4382Å lines

external_data.citation: (cite: chen05; christensen14; straka16; moller18; rhodin18; rao03)

recipe.method: Pipeline calibration, AIPS self-cal of continuum for two fields, continuum subtraction, natural-weighted CASA imaging, primary beam correction

recipe.goal: Extract CO spectra and measure sizes
recipe.method: Flux per channel in elliptical region containing emission; sizes with CASA fitter
Convert CO(2-1) to CO(1-0) luminosity and apply alpha_CO
assumptions: alpha_CO = 4.36 Msun (K km/s pc^2)^-1; CO(2-1)/(1-0) flux ratio 2.5

recipe.method: SED fitting of multi-band photometry with BC03 templates, chi2 minimisation over grid
key_parameters: ages 0.01-13.5 Gyr; e-folding 0.1-30 Gyr; A_V 0-1 mag

recipe.goal: Compare with COLD GASS and PHIBSS
recipe.method: Compare SFR, Mmol, fmol, depletion times against emission-selected samples with same alpha_CO

evidence.quote: the median gas depletion time for the DLA galaxies is $\rm \tau_{\rm depl,DLA} \approx 10$ Gyr

not_stated_but_needed: CASA version and tclean parameters (cell, image size, masking, deconvolution)
Stellar-mass photometry sources and SFR values per galaxy
How uncertainties on line fluxes were derived
Flux calibrators and flux scale uncertainty
score_reason: Public data and simple derivations, but imaging details and photometry/SFR inputs are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric CO fluxes and masses via a simple recipe.
